intro.title: Meet the Dongfeng 06
paragraphs: The Dongfeng 06 is built for those who want it all - space, style and electric efficiency in one versatile package. With a bold silhouette and a confident stance, the 06 delivers SUV practicality without compromising on modern design.

Whether you're navigating city streets or heading out on a weekend adventure, the 06 combines generous interior space, a capable electric drivetrain and smart technology into a driving experience that adapts to your lifestyle.

features.title: Crystal LED Headlights
features.description: Sharp, precisely crafted LED headlights deliver outstanding visibility while giving the 06 a striking front-end presence that stands out on any road.

features.title: Interactive Tail Lights
features.description: Dynamic LED tail lights feature animated light sequences that respond to driving conditions, enhancing rear visibility while creating a distinctive signature look.

features.title: Custom Sports Rims
features.description: Lightweight alloy sports rims add a bold, athletic edge to the 06's profile while optimising aerodynamics for improved range and efficiency.

features.title: Electric Door Release
features.description: A sleek electronic door release replaces traditional handles for a cleaner exterior profile, opening effortlessly at the touch of a button.

features.title: Convenient Split Tailgate
features.description: A cleverly designed split tailgate offers flexible loading options, making it easy to access the boot whether you're picking up groceries or loading larger items.

sections.title: Find Your Perfect Colour
sections.subtitle: Express your personality with a range of bold and refined colour options.

features.title: Infotainment System
features.description: A large, responsive touchscreen puts navigation, media, vehicle settings and connectivity at your fingertips through a clean, intuitive interface.

features.title: Transformable Bed Interior
features.description: Fold the rear seats flat to create a spacious, comfortable rest area - perfect for road trips, camping or simply taking a break on a long journey.

features.title: Wireless Phone Charger
features.description: Keep your device powered without the clutter of cables using the integrated wireless charging pad, conveniently placed within easy reach.

sections.title: Protection You Can Count On
sections.subtitle: The 06 is equipped with intelligent safety systems designed to keep you and your passengers safe on every journey.

features.title: Intelligent Active Safety Assistants
features.description: A suite of advanced driver assistance systems works together to monitor your surroundings, alert you to potential hazards and intervene when needed to help prevent collisions.

features.title: Multi-Scene Intelligent Parking
features.description: Advanced parking assistance handles a variety of parking scenarios, using sensors and cameras to guide you into tight spots with confidence and precision.

features.title: Comfy Eco Friendly Cabin
features.description: Sustainable materials and soft-touch surfaces create a cabin that feels premium and welcoming while being mindful of the environment.

features.title: Multi-Function Steering Wheel
features.description: Keep your hands on the wheel and your focus on the road with intuitive controls for audio, phone, cruise control and driver assistance features.

features.title: Practical Interior
features.description: Thoughtfully designed storage throughout the cabin keeps your essentials organised and within reach, making everyday driving effortless.

features.title: Smart Ambient Lighting
features.description: Customisable ambient lighting sets the mood for every drive, bathing the cabin in your choice of colour to match your style or the moment.

cta.subtitle: Ready to see what the 06 can do? Book a test drive today and discover versatile electric driving for yourself.
